slots.notes: object-cover founder/testimonial portrait in a fixed 250x310px frame, overlaid by decorative CSS glitch blocks (the blocks are bg-white divs, not assets)

mechanic: Framer Motion useInView staggered reveal of a header, a glitch-block portrait, and a testimonial quote beside a 1:1 radial circle diagram whose three angled labels and radiating SVG lines bold-and-brighten on shared hover.
techDelivery: single-component React 18 + TypeScript spec using Tailwind CSS 3 utility classes and Framer Motion v12 (motion components, useState, useRef, useInView)
reskinNotes: All copy is hardcoded in markup; hex values are baked into Tailwind arbitrary-value classes (bg-[#0f0f0f], text-[#6e6e6e], text-[#555]) and into an inline SVG stroke="white"; the radial layout is geometry-baked — label angles (215/335/110 deg) and the 10 glitch-block coordinates are hardcoded into per-element trig/percentage positioning rather than data-driven, so changing label count or portrait size requires editing the component.
